about_the_game:
BECOME A LEGEND

iBasket Manager 3 is the ultimate multiplayer sports simulation game for basketball lovers. Not only do you manage a team, you become the real owner of a club that you can customize and grow like never before.

Buy, trade, and upgrade your in-game assets, build your space in the iBasket Manager 3 universe, and lead your franchise to glory.

BUILD AN EMPIRE

Here, you don't just manage, you also create. Design and develop your exclusive plot within the game world, building everything from sports facilities to decorative elements that enhance the value of your club. Every decision counts, and your space evolves with you.

CHALLENGE MANAGERS FROM AROUND THE WORLD

Be part of a global competition with dynamic seasons, where promotion or relegation depends on your performance in each game. Participate in the iBasket League, compete in the iBasket Cup, and organize your own private leagues to challenge your friends on the court.

THINK LIKE A PROFESSIONAL COACH

Define every tactical detail: from defensive intensity to offensive strategy, player rotation, and game pace management. Do you prefer an explosive, vertical style or a methodical, possession-based approach? Every decision impacts the game. Show off your coaching vision.

LIVE EACH GAME IN REAL TIME

Enjoy an advanced simulation engine that lets you follow the games as if you were on the bench. Feel the excitement of every three-pointer, every block, and every assist. Grow your fan base and turn your arena into a real fortress.

iBASKET PASS

Earn special rewards as you progress through each season. The iBasket Pass includes up to 25 levels per season that you can unlock by playing. Access exclusive rewards with the iBasket Pass Premium (by redeeming Ucoins) and make every minute of play bring you closer to new improvements for your club.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1, 8/8.1, 10
  • Processor: Intel I3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel GMA X4500, NVIDIA GeForce 9600M GT or AMD/ATI Mobility Radeon HD 3650 - 256MB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
